name: Journey of Mankind (Safar-e-Insaan)
changelog_en: Prehistoric Clan Partner System with dialogues & family legacy, lifelike human physiology (fatigue, shivering, panting, bedroll sleep), dynamic weather audio (rain on leaves vs roof, spatial thunder), 4-sample round-robin footsteps with gear rustle, canine companion whistle (Key P), sizzling campfire cooking, and dedicated Audio Settings Menu.
changelog_ur: Qadeem Hamsafar & Partner Nizam ba-ma guftagoo aur agli nasal ka aaghaz, asli insani jism (thakawat, thand se kapkapahat, haanpna, bistar par aaram), mausam ki aawazain (chhat par aur khulay asman talay barish, garaj chamak), 4 variations walay qadmon ki aawazain aur leather rustle, kuttay ki seeti (P key), bhoonay gosht ki aawaz, aur mukammal Awaz Settings Menu.
